cards.name: Start a Mission Reminder — SGE
cards.oracleText:
Start a mission N

A player can’t start a mission N if they already have a mission or don’t control untapped creatures with total power N or greater. To start a mission N, that player taps any number of untapped creatures they control with total power N or greater, then exiles the top N cards of their library face down as a mission. They may look at those cards for as long as they remain exiled. At the beginning of their next upkeep, they debrief that mission.

To debrief a mission, reveal the cards in that mission. Put one into your hand, put one on the bottom of your library, and you may play the remaining card from exile this turn. If you cast a spell this way, it costs {1} less to cast for each exploration counter you have.
